programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.desc: El presidente Donald Trump no tiene rival a la hora de entender en qué se han convertido los medios de comunicación. Su estrategia es atacarles en su propio terreno y, la mayoría de las veces, sale vencedor.

programme.title: David Harris Jr. The Pulse
programme.desc: Análisis contundentes y la opinión sobre las últimas noticias y acontecimientos de actualidad.

programme.title: Wise Guys With John Tabacco
programme.desc: Un equipo de analistas abordan los grandes problemas y revelan la hipocresía de las políticas peligrosas de las élites.

programme.title: Cops Under Fire
programme.desc: El crimen y los asesinatos arrasan con la nación y Chicago es uno de los principales. Un policía analiza el estado del crimen en las calles de Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Voices of Valor
programme.desc: Carl Higbie conversa con tres veteranos para dialogar sobre las fallas del departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos, la creciente debilidad de la sociedad estadounidense y las dificultades que enfrentan los veteranos al reintegrarse a la vida civil.

programme.title: American Hero: The John Wayne Story
programme.desc: Se explora al ícono de Hollywood más legendario de todos los tiempos: John Wayne.

programme.title: Stand Up Trump: Making America Fun Again
programme.desc: A diferencia de cualquier presidente que lo haya precedido, Donald J. Trump es un comandante en jefe que no se limita a salirse del guion, a veces simplemente se sale.

programme.title: Stand Up Trump: Making America Fun Again
programme.desc: Donald Trump puede haber tomado a muchos por sorpresa con su improbable victoria en las elecciones presidenciales de 2016, pero nadie pensaría que llegaría a conmocionar al mundo.

programme.title: Ronald Reagan: His Winning Wit
programme.desc: El presidente Reagan era conocido como un gran comunicador, estableció un vínculo con el público y se ganó el cariño de sus compatriotas. Algunos de sus momentos más divertidos y grandiosos y cómo se convirtió en uno de los presidentes más queridos.

programme.title: Wake Up America Early

programme.title: Wake Up America
programme.desc: Las noticias ocurridas hasta el momento y el análisis para comenzar el día bien informado.

programme.desc: Learn when to use front vs back loop in overlay mosaic crochet to control color—hide or reveal yarn for clean, crisp designs.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Sharp and Attractive Way to Store Kitchen Knives
programme.desc: A great way to safely store kitchen knives, up and out of the way but also easily accessible.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: AWFS 2007 Special - Part 1 of 2
programme.desc: Special episode of The Wood Whisperer on location at AWFS fair in Los Vegas!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Setting Up a Dado Blade
programme.desc: A hassle-free method for setting up a dado blade with no measuring! All it takes is a flat surface and one of the most sensitive measuring devices in your shop: your fingers!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Duane’s Steamer Trunk Part 4
programme.desc: The final installment of the Steamer Trunk series. I apply the faux walnut straps, apply the water-based finish using my HVLP turbine, and install the tansu hardware. All in all, this was a great project that really reinforces simple frame and panel construction.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: SketchUp Basics - Trunk Lid Part 3
programme.desc: In the final part of our series, Aaron puts the finishing touches on the trunk lid. If this is your first experience with SketchUp, I highly recommend checking out the tutorials located at Sketch Up For Woodworkers

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: You Don't Need Breadboard Ends - Ask TWW
programme.desc: You don't need breadboard ends - and that's why.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 10 Things I Wish I Knew When I Started Woodworking
programme.desc: Some tips that might save you some heartache, time and money.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Wall-Hanging Tool Chest Part 3
programme.desc: This one is all about assembly! I receive a lot of requests to include more details on my assembly process. This is a detail that many articles, videos, and DVDs tend to leave out, so hopefully this helps to fill some gaps. Keep in mind that every project will require a different glueup and clamping strategy, and this is just one way to get the job done.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Automate Your Dust Collection with iVac
programme.desc: Blast gates that open and close automatically? Yes, please!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Installing Nordfab Ductwork
programme.desc: After installing the Clear Vue CV1800 cyclone, the next step was to install the Nordfab ductwork. This video shows you how I did the job and how this system works.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: SketchUp Basics - Trunk Lid Part 2
programme.desc: In part two of our three-part series, Aaron shows us how to make the frame parts for the top of our lid. Now these videos do assume that you’ve opened the program and have a little familiarity with the tools.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 5 Tips for Laying Out Project Parts
programme.desc: Whenever I lay out my project parts in rough lumber, I find that there are 5 things that I always try to keep in mind.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Review of the Earlex Spray Station 5000
programme.desc: This video covers my initial impressions and experience with the Earlex Spray Station 5000, an HVLP turbine.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 2019 Shop Tour - Layout - Tools - Organization - Tech & Safety
programme.desc: It’s been a while since I’ve done a shop tour. We look at layout, tools, organization, tech, and safety. I hope you enjoy!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Pare Essentials
programme.desc: In this episode, Marc works on two different projects. Learn how to finish up a step stool and Japanese cocktail table in one video!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Relative Dimensioning
programme.desc: The idea is simple: let the pre-existing parts of your project dictate the size of subsequent parts. And in many cases, this is much easier and far more accurate than measuring with a tape or ruler.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 10
programme.desc: I cut and fit the door components. I also cut the mortise and tenon joinery for the rails and stiles. A stupid mistake causes a small injury and a bit of a setback, so the last part of the video is dedicated to fixing that mistake.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Best Food Safe Finish
programme.desc: Don't waste your time with mineral oil. You have a better option!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 5
programme.desc: Road Trip! I was originally convinced that the Gadget Station would call for knife hinges. But just for fun, I decided to take a trip to my local Woodcraft to see what they might suggest. Well, surprise surprise! I discovered a hinge that I had never noticed before. The Soss Invisible Hinge.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Aging Wood with Baking Soda
programme.desc: While you are probably familiar with the pigment and dye-based stains available on the market, you might not be aware of a whole other class of stains known as chemical stains. Woods like mahogany and cherry are great candidates for chemical staining with baking soda but a wood like maple doesn't have much change, as you'll see in the video.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Turning a Vampire Stake
programme.desc: Turning on the lathe is one of the most relaxing and enjoyable parts of woodworking. Every time I turn I ask myself, “Why don’t I do this more often?” I still don’t have an answer to that. But recently, I had the opportunity to turn a cool item for a charity event.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Jory Brigham’s Hank Chair
programme.desc: A look at how Jory builds his Hank Chair.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Hand-Cut Half-Blind Dovetails
programme.desc: Dovetails: very few joints are held in such high regard. I’m not sure why exactly, but there seems to be a nearly universal love and adoration for this flying vermin-inspired interlocking joint.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Mystery Tools
programme.desc: A look at a few tools you may not have seen before.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: End Grain Sanding Test - How High Should You Go?
programme.desc: Are there diminishing returns when sanding end grain?

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Buy This Not That - Measuring and Marking
programme.desc: Tools I think you should buy as well as tools I think you should avoid.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Turning a Tiny Finial
programme.desc: A few months ago, renowned turner Ashley Harwood came out to visit the shop. Coincidentally, my new Powermatic 3520C lathe has just arrived. What better way to break in the new lathe than to have an expert give it a solid workout.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Safety Q&A
programme.desc: I received a number of great questions for Safety Week and this video covers three of them. The first question concerns running small pieces over the tablesaw and router. The second question is about the proper installation and safe use of a dado blade. The final question concerns the disposal of chemicals and hazardous waste in the shop.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Flexible Sanding Strip
programme.desc: The first time I saw a flexible sanding strip in action was while watching an episode of Woodworks going on almost 10 years ago. David Marks incorporates lots of curves in his work and the man knows a thing or two about making them. Since then, I have made numerous sanding strips in all shapes and sizes and my curves are about as perfect and smooth as they can be.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Salt Cellar
programme.desc: After posting the video for the Kitchen Helper, several folks asked if I built the little salt cellar we have in our kitchen. I didn't. But I decided the design was straightforward enough that I'd try to make a copy for myself and maybe a few extra as gifts. If you or someone in your life loves to cook, you are definitely going to want to make a few!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Adjustable-Height Work Support
programme.desc: Build a simple adjustable-height work support.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Installing Drawer Fronts the Easy Way!
programme.desc: Stop struggling with drawer fronts once and for all!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Moving Experience
programme.desc: Moving an entire wood shop is no fun. But you can save yourself a lot of backaches if you hire some help. Money well-spent if you ask me. I'll show you everything I did to get my shop ready for the road trip. By no means is this meant to be a guide of any sort. Rather, its just a peek into my personal experience. And if you ever have to move your own shop, you’ll know what you’re in for.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Nicole’s Picture Frame
programme.desc: About 4 days before Christmas, I started making a nice little picture frame for a custom piece of art I had made up for Nicole. A gift for a special girl requires some special wood. So I pulled out my best sheets of curly maple veneer and a couple of sheets of home-sawn afzelia wood that I received from David Marks.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Backlit LED Poster Frame Light Box
programme.desc: Nicole and I love movies and we are lucky to have our own home theater room. Just outside that room, is a recess with an outlet on the wall intended for a back-lit poster frame. The one that came with the house was made with fluorescent tubes and was falling apart. So this is my replacement. It features a dimmable LED light strip and a double-sided poster and accEPts 27″ x 40″ posters.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 7
programme.desc: I made quite a bit of progress in this video. The legs are cut from the bubinga blanks, and I finally have an opportunity to do a dry fit. I am in for a surprise as you will see, and a change is made to the original plans.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Advent Calendar Part 1
programme.desc: This Advent calendar is relatively basic in design, but has 25 little cubbies with enough room for a special treat or a secret message. In the first part of the two-part series, I start working on the grid structure and the hanging of the doors. The grid structure is creating using a shop-made jig that is very similar to a box-joint jig.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Platform Bed - The Footboard
programme.desc: We take a fast-paced look at how a platform bed went together and gives you a broad overview of the techniques and tools used. We break down rough stock and create the massive footboard.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Tool Storage Cabinet
programme.desc: Tool storage is a challenge for any workshop. My current dilemma is how to store my portable power tools so that they are out of their cases and accessible. There is no one-size-fits-all solution, but I hope sharing my thoughts on this topic will at least get your gears turning so you can tackle the storage challenges in your own shop.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Chiseling a Corner
programme.desc: I recently had to cut a large rabbet using a rabbeting bit which resulted in rounded corners. While this process may be common sense to some, the actual steps taken to achieve a perfect continuation of the rabbeted edge without mangling the integrity of the lines requires quite a bit of attention to detail. So this is a step by step review of my process.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: I’m Getting Rid of My Roubo - New Workbench Tour
programme.desc: I'm auctioning off my old Roubo workbench for charity and built a new Hybrid Workbench to replace it.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Which Sander Should You Buy?
programme.desc: In the market for a premium sander but can't decide between the Festool and the Mirka? You've come to the right place!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Resin Cast Memory Frames
programme.desc: For this year's Woodworker's Fighting Cancer project, we're building memory frames. Inside the frame, we'll use epoxy to create a casting. This space can be used for memorabilia, fun stuff for the kids, or whatever kind of decoration you want.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Breadboard Ends - The Joint Most People Get Wrong
programme.desc: Four ways to make proper breadboard ends.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Guild to Woodworking Clamps aka The Big Squeeze
programme.desc: Not sure what woodworking clamps to buy? In this episode, Marc will answer all your questions and guide you to the best clamps!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Waterborne Finishes & HVLP
programme.desc: Technically, this is really Part 4 of our Wall-Hanging Tool Chest build, but because I focused so strongly on waterborne finishes and HVLP (High Volume Low Pressure spraying), it received its own stand-alone title.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: This Spatula Cost Me $33 000!
programme.desc: Making your own spatula is super easy with $33k worth of tools!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Relative Dimensioning
programme.desc: The idea is simple: let the pre-existing parts of your project dictate the size of subsequent parts. And in many cases, this is much easier and far more accurate than measuring with a tape or ruler.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 10
programme.desc: I cut and fit the door components. I also cut the mortise and tenon joinery for the rails and stiles. A stupid mistake causes a small injury and a bit of a setback, so the last part of the video is dedicated to fixing that mistake.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Best Food Safe Finish
programme.desc: Don't waste your time with mineral oil. You have a better option!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 5
programme.desc: Road Trip! I was originally convinced that the Gadget Station would call for knife hinges. But just for fun, I decided to take a trip to my local Woodcraft to see what they might suggest. Well, surprise surprise! I discovered a hinge that I had never noticed before. The Soss Invisible Hinge.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Aging Wood with Baking Soda
programme.desc: While you are probably familiar with the pigment and dye-based stains available on the market, you might not be aware of a whole other class of stains known as chemical stains. Woods like mahogany and cherry are great candidates for chemical staining with baking soda but a wood like maple doesn't have much change, as you'll see in the video.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Turning a Vampire Stake
programme.desc: Turning on the lathe is one of the most relaxing and enjoyable parts of woodworking. Every time I turn I ask myself, “Why don’t I do this more often?” I still don’t have an answer to that. But recently, I had the opportunity to turn a cool item for a charity event.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Jory Brigham’s Hank Chair
programme.desc: A look at how Jory builds his Hank Chair.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Hand-Cut Half-Blind Dovetails
programme.desc: Dovetails: very few joints are held in such high regard. I’m not sure why exactly, but there seems to be a nearly universal love and adoration for this flying vermin-inspired interlocking joint.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Mystery Tools
programme.desc: A look at a few tools you may not have seen before.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: End Grain Sanding Test - How High Should You Go?
programme.desc: Are there diminishing returns when sanding end grain?

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Buy This Not That - Measuring and Marking
programme.desc: Tools I think you should buy as well as tools I think you should avoid.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Turning a Tiny Finial
programme.desc: A few months ago, renowned turner Ashley Harwood came out to visit the shop. Coincidentally, my new Powermatic 3520C lathe has just arrived. What better way to break in the new lathe than to have an expert give it a solid workout.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Safety Q&A
programme.desc: I received a number of great questions for Safety Week and this video covers three of them. The first question concerns running small pieces over the tablesaw and router. The second question is about the proper installation and safe use of a dado blade. The final question concerns the disposal of chemicals and hazardous waste in the shop.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Flexible Sanding Strip
programme.desc: The first time I saw a flexible sanding strip in action was while watching an episode of Woodworks going on almost 10 years ago. David Marks incorporates lots of curves in his work and the man knows a thing or two about making them. Since then, I have made numerous sanding strips in all shapes and sizes and my curves are about as perfect and smooth as they can be.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Salt Cellar
programme.desc: After posting the video for the Kitchen Helper, several folks asked if I built the little salt cellar we have in our kitchen. I didn't. But I decided the design was straightforward enough that I'd try to make a copy for myself and maybe a few extra as gifts. If you or someone in your life loves to cook, you are definitely going to want to make a few!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Adjustable-Height Work Support
programme.desc: Build a simple adjustable-height work support.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Installing Drawer Fronts the Easy Way!
programme.desc: Stop struggling with drawer fronts once and for all!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Moving Experience
programme.desc: Moving an entire wood shop is no fun. But you can save yourself a lot of backaches if you hire some help. Money well-spent if you ask me. I'll show you everything I did to get my shop ready for the road trip. By no means is this meant to be a guide of any sort. Rather, its just a peek into my personal experience. And if you ever have to move your own shop, you’ll know what you’re in for.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Nicole’s Picture Frame
programme.desc: About 4 days before Christmas, I started making a nice little picture frame for a custom piece of art I had made up for Nicole. A gift for a special girl requires some special wood. So I pulled out my best sheets of curly maple veneer and a couple of sheets of home-sawn afzelia wood that I received from David Marks.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Backlit LED Poster Frame Light Box
programme.desc: Nicole and I love movies and we are lucky to have our own home theater room. Just outside that room, is a recess with an outlet on the wall intended for a back-lit poster frame. The one that came with the house was made with fluorescent tubes and was falling apart. So this is my replacement. It features a dimmable LED light strip and a double-sided poster and accEPts 27″ x 40″ posters.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 7
programme.desc: I made quite a bit of progress in this video. The legs are cut from the bubinga blanks, and I finally have an opportunity to do a dry fit. I am in for a surprise as you will see, and a change is made to the original plans.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Advent Calendar Part 1
programme.desc: This Advent calendar is relatively basic in design, but has 25 little cubbies with enough room for a special treat or a secret message. In the first part of the two-part series, I start working on the grid structure and the hanging of the doors. The grid structure is creating using a shop-made jig that is very similar to a box-joint jig.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Platform Bed - The Footboard
programme.desc: We take a fast-paced look at how a platform bed went together and gives you a broad overview of the techniques and tools used. We break down rough stock and create the massive footboard.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Tool Storage Cabinet
programme.desc: Tool storage is a challenge for any workshop. My current dilemma is how to store my portable power tools so that they are out of their cases and accessible. There is no one-size-fits-all solution, but I hope sharing my thoughts on this topic will at least get your gears turning so you can tackle the storage challenges in your own shop.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Chiseling a Corner
programme.desc: I recently had to cut a large rabbet using a rabbeting bit which resulted in rounded corners. While this process may be common sense to some, the actual steps taken to achieve a perfect continuation of the rabbeted edge without mangling the integrity of the lines requires quite a bit of attention to detail. So this is a step by step review of my process.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: I’m Getting Rid of My Roubo - New Workbench Tour
programme.desc: I'm auctioning off my old Roubo workbench for charity and built a new Hybrid Workbench to replace it.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Which Sander Should You Buy?
programme.desc: In the market for a premium sander but can't decide between the Festool and the Mirka? You've come to the right place!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Resin Cast Memory Frames
programme.desc: For this year's Woodworker's Fighting Cancer project, we're building memory frames. Inside the frame, we'll use epoxy to create a casting. This space can be used for memorabilia, fun stuff for the kids, or whatever kind of decoration you want.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Breadboard Ends - The Joint Most People Get Wrong
programme.desc: Four ways to make proper breadboard ends.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Guild to Woodworking Clamps aka The Big Squeeze
programme.desc: Not sure what woodworking clamps to buy? In this episode, Marc will answer all your questions and guide you to the best clamps!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Waterborne Finishes & HVLP
programme.desc: Technically, this is really Part 4 of our Wall-Hanging Tool Chest build, but because I focused so strongly on waterborne finishes and HVLP (High Volume Low Pressure spraying), it received its own stand-alone title.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso se despierta con la llegada de la primavera. Mientras corre por el bosque, se topa con una hermosa Osa. Muy pronto, se enamora. Recoge algunas flores y chocolates y corre hacia ella, con la esperanza de invitarla a salir en una cita. Y por supuesto, Masha estropea todos sus planes. El Oso hace lo imposible por deshacerse de la niña que perturba su idilio. La Osa por fin le presta atención al Oso y exige una explicación. El Oso trata de explicar pero se enfrenta a un dilema: Masha o la Osa. El Oso no logra decidirse sin dudar y la Osa se va con otro oso.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso está cansado de ser el niñero eterno de Masha y de Panda, ¡que han destruido toda la casa! Decide descansar un poco y contrata a una niñera especial para sus "angelitos…

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: ¡Qué gran descubrimiento en el bosque! ¡Masha encuentra un sombrero vivo! ¿Vale la pena decir lo encantada que esta traviesa por todas las maravillas que suceden a su alrededor? Pero todo tiene un maestro, y resulta que el sombrero no es una excepción.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso decide cosechar bayas y preparar una mermelada. La idea complace mucho el paladar de Masha, que se la come toda. Más tarde, decide ponerse un frasco de vidrio en la cabeza para interpretar a un astronauta. El Oso trata de liberar la cabeza de Masha y al final lo logra, pero en el proceso su propia pata queda atrapada en el frasco. Se pasa el resto del día intentando liberar su pata.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Este cuento de hadas trata sobre un pequeño e ingenioso sastre, que tuvo la oportunidad de derrotar al gigante y obtener un refrigerador lleno de dulces. Así que se los comió todos a la vez. Luego decidió salir a la calle, pero no pudo, ya que comió en exceso y se atascó en la puerta. Esta historia nos enseña una lección vital para no ser codiciosos y comer demasiado; de lo contrario, podríamos meternos en una situación complicada.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Este cuento nos habla de un Califa de Oriente, que solía sentarse todo el día frente a la ventana y escuchar el canto de las aves. El Califa era muy poderoso, pero había una cosa que lo decepcionaba: no podía entender el lenguaje de las aves. El pobre Califa se puso a llorar y nadie pudo hacerlo reír. Un día, un enano llegó con el Califa. Prometió ayudarlo a convertirlo en cigüeña. El Califa estuvo de acuerdo y se convirtió en cigüeña. Mientras tanto, el enano se sentó en el trono y se autoproclamó Califa. La pobre cigüeña rompió a llorar y le rogó al enano que le devolviera su apariencia humana y su realeza. Nada hubiera salvado al Califa si un loro pequeño no lo hubiera ayudado a hechizar al enano y devolverle la apariencia humana. Masha concluye que es muy importante aprender idiomas extranjeros.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Una mujer enojada tenía dos hijas, una propia y la segunda, una hijastra. La mujer mimó a su propia hija y obligó a la hijastra a trabajar muy duro. Una vez la mujer llevó a su hijastra al bosque y la dejó allí. La niña conoció a Baba Jaga y Padre Hielo allí, quienes la defendieron y la llevaron a su casa. Cuando la niña demostró ser trabajadora y ordenada, Padre Hielo junto con los hermanos “12 meses” le dieron muchos regalos y la enviaron a casa sana y salva. Al ver los regalos, la mujer envió a su propia hija al bosque, pero la niña fue grosera con Padre Hielo y se convirtió en una mujer de nieve como castigo.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Esta historia trata sobre Yemelya, su esposa perezosa y Lucio, que interpreta el papel de un pez de colores en esta historia. La moraleja de la historia: antes de pedir un deseo, es necesario pensar en las consecuencias para ti y las personas que te rodean.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Había un pueblo y un hombre viviendo en este pueblo. En un bosque profundo cerca de ese pueblo, el Oso se instaló. El Oso le pidió al hombre algunos bocadillos. El hombre le dio al oso dos opciones de lo que prefería comer: las puntas o las raíces. El oso decidió tomar las puntas. El hombre cultivó un nabo y le dio las copas al oso. Las copas eran de mal gusto. El Oso le pidió al hombre que probara el nabo. El hombre estuvo de acuerdo con la condición de que el oso lo ayudara con las tareas del hogar y lo mantuviera alejado de las moscas. Mientras ahuyentaba a las moscas, el oso golpeó accidentalmente al hombre en la nariz. El Oso se asustó y se escapó al bosque, llevando el nabo con él. Desde entonces, la gente suele decir "nadie sabe para quien trabaja”.

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: ¡A todos los niños les gustan los juegos de computadora! A todo el mundo le gusta dispararle a un par de monstruos antes de irse a dormir. ¡A Tolik también le gustaba jugar a los tiradores hasta que los monstruos lo atacaron en realidad y tomaron venganza! O ... ¿fue solo un sueño? Veamos...

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: ¡Un niño le tenía tanto miedo al agua que dejó de bañarse y se convirtió en un cerdito! ¡Todos sus amigos huyeron de él asustados! Pero al final superó su miedo y comenzó a lavarse la cara y las manos al darse cuenta de que el agua puede ser segura y divertida. ¡El niño fue muy valiente e incluso ganó una competencia de natación!

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: ¿Sabes la razón por la que los humanoides intentan secuestrar a niños pequeños? ¿No? Entonces, escúchenme chicos… Había una vez un niño que estaba interesado en dos cosas: libros sobre diferentes humanoides y dulces. Y así… mientras leía un libro, ¡escuchó un ruido extraño! Bueno, ¿a quién crees que pertenecía? ¿Humanoides? ¿Existen después de todo? Bueno, encontrarás la respuesta en este episodio.

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: Si crees que solo los niños pequeños tienen miedo de algo, ¡no es verdad! Incluso un animal tan alto como la jirafa tiene sus propios miedos... Por ejemplo, tiene miedo de perder de vista a sus padres y perderse en un safari por el desierto. Masha descubre una extraña ley de la naturaleza: ¡incluso las criaturas más altas pueden ser pequeñas frente a los problemas e incluso la más pequeña puede superar cualquier problema!

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: Los niños le tienen miedo a la oscuridad. ¡Masha también le tenía miedo y tuvo que sentarse con una antorcha toda la noche! Pero una vez se le ocurrió la historia de un pequeño insecto que vivía en el bosque y le tenía tanto miedo a la oscuridad, que cada crujido hacía temblar su corazón. El insecto sufrió mucho hasta que se dio cuenta de que todas las cosas diminutas que ves en la oscuridad parecen ser espantosas y el miedo no tiene ningún sentido.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Oso se mezcla en una historia de juego muy desagradable. Está listo para pasar todo el día jugando todo tipo de juegos en la computadora. Él dejó sin hacer los deberes de la casa, sus tareas y hasta sus amigos. Parece que el juego le ha ganado, ¡Masha tendrá que apurarse y ayudar a su mejor amigo antes de que sea demasiado tarde!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso organiza su fiesta de cumpleaños. Todos los animales llegan a su casa para felicitarlo y le llevan algunos regalos. Al ver esto, Masha decide prepararse para su propia fiesta de cumpleaños para evitar cualquier posibilidad de que los animales se olviden de su fiesta y de toda la lista de regalos.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha quiere comer unos dulces, pero antes debe transformar la cocina del Oso en una fábrica de caramelos. Como todos sabemos, una vida llena de dulces es sinónimo de problemas, y pronto a Masha le da dolor de muelas. Hay una lección para todos los niños a los que les gustan los dulces: ¡cuídense bien los dientes!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Todos tienen su comida favorita. Nuestros amigos están listos para disfrutar de algo delicioso en el episodio nuevo. ¿Puede un bocadillo ser sabroso y saludable al mismo tiempo? Masha busca la respuesta a esta simple pregunta y una vez más está convencida de que no hay nada mejor que la avena. ¿Quieres encontrar la respuesta? ¡Mira este episodio y compruébalo por ti mismo!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El otoño ha llegado. El Oso arma una barrera contra Masha en la puerta de su casa para prepararse para su siesta invernal. Pero la niña se las ingenia para entrar y desata una vez más el caos cuando despierta a todo un enjambre de abejas. Pero todos sus juegos por fin llegan a su fin, y cuando el Oso cocina crema de avena para alimentarla, la encuentra dormida.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha decide intentar el papel de súper heroína: con valentía, se embarca en variadas proezas, pero todos los animales se ríen de su disfraz casero y de su inocente deseo de rescatarlos. ¿Quién habría pensado que la valentía de Masha realmente los salvaría a todos? Todos terminan entendiendo que el disfraz de superhéroe no es el elemento más esencial para realizar actos heroicos.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso va a pescar. Esperanzado, lanza la línea de su caña de pescar, y en cuanto el primer pez muerde la carnada, aparece Masha y transforma un agradable viaje de pesca en una pesadilla. El Oso le construye una caña de pescar a Masha para mantenerla entretenida, y de inmediato Masha pesca al pez.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Los lobos van a cocinar borsch bajo la dirección de Masha. Tienen un libro de cocina, una olla grande y un apetito voraz. ¡Pero aún necesitan conseguir los ingredientes! Parece que los recién graduados especialistas culinarios van a tener algo interesante.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso juega al ajedrez. Masha lo interrumpe para pedirle que la alimente. El Oso le cocina crema de avena, pero a Masha no le gusta. El Oso se va de la casa hecho una furia. Masha decide cocinarse su propia crema de avena. Pero muy pronto, la crema se hincha y se expande. Todos los habitantes del bosque recordarán este día por mucho tiempo...

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso rememora sus logros del pasado cuando formaba parte del circo y recrea algunos de sus trucos más famosos sobre un monociclo. Por desgracia, se resbala y cae de cabeza. De pronto, todas las cosas que hace se parecen sospechosamente a la conducta infantil de Masha.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: ¿Sabes qué es la ornitología? ¡Es la ciencia que estudia las aves! Y también es el pasatiempo nuevo de Dasha. ¡Va a visitar a Masha y a Oso y descubre una nueva especie de ave única! ¿Qué es esta increíble ave inusual? ¡Date prisa y mira este episodio nuevo para descubrirlo!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha y el Pingüino van a Marte y de allí directamente al mar abierto hacia la Princesa Rana, y nuevas aventuras ya esperan a los amigos en cubierta. ¿Cómo apareció todo esto en la casa del Oso?

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: La Osa le muestra a Masha una revista glamorosa, y ahora el Oso transformará su casa en un salón de belleza. Prepárate para aprender la lección de que todo deber hacerse con un sentido de proporción, en especial lo que respecta a la belleza.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha quiere aprender a patinar sobre hielo. Pero no hay nadie cerca para enseñarle, porque el Oso se quedó dormido. Sin embargo, esto no es obstáculo en lo más mínimo para Masha. Le calza los patines en las patas al Oso y lo hace rodar hacia el estanque helado, donde por fin se despierta. Ahora el Oso no tiene opción más que enseñarle a patinar a la niña impaciente.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Un viejo amigo viene a visitar al Oso y le trae un juego increíble, un billar. Es una perfecta ocasión para competir y divertirse. Pero la cosa se tuerce cuando Masha entra en el juego para complicarlo todo. ¿Quién será el mejor jugador en esta emocionante competición? ¡Busca la respuesta en este nuevo capítulo!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Oso odia decir adiós a Masha y no soporta estar lejos de ella. Mientras tanto, otros habitantes del bosque se están tomando un descanso en el patio sin saber que su frágil paraíso está al borde del colapso, ya que Oso recibe una esperada llamada de Masha ...

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: ¿Quién serás cuando crezcas? Encontrar respuesta a esta pregunta es uno de los procesos más difíciles para cada niño, y Masha no es excepción. El Oso la convence de que en cualquier situación lo más importante es seguir siendo tú mismo.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Masha narra el cuento de hadas ruso sobre la doncella de nieve que fue moldeada por la abuela y el abuelo. La doncella de nieve creció muy rápido. La abuela y el abuelo se preocupaban mucho por ella y no la dejaban salir de la casa para evitar que se derritiera. Cuando llegó el verano la metieron en el refrigerador. Cuando los abuelos salieron de la casa y la Doncella de Nieve salió a lanzar fuegos artificiales con otros niños y a saltar sobre el fuego. Saltó directamente al fuego y se derritió de inmediato. La moraleja de la historia es que los niños no deben jugar con fuego y fuegos artificiales para estar seguros.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Mamá le pidió a Caperucita Roja que le llevara algunos pasteles a su abuela. Los pasteles olían tan delicioso que la niña decidió sentarse a comer un pastel. De repente, el conejito Roly-Poly se sentó a su lado, por lo que decidió llevarlo con ella a la abuela. Al mismo tiempo, el Lobo, que estaba cerca, escuchó a Caperucita Roja, corrió a la casa de la abuela, se la comió y esperó a que llegara la niña. Cuando apareció, el lobo se la comió junto con el conejito, pero le empezó a doler el estómago, por lo que explotó. El conejito corrió, pero tuvo la mala suerte de encontrarse con el Zorro, que se lo comió. De esta historia, Masha concluye que es muy importante visitar a tu abuela con más frecuencia y ser más prudente.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Había un niño llamado Jack. Era tan pobre que ninguna chica querría casarse con él. Un día fue al mercado a vender la vaca y comprarse un traje. De camino al mercado, Jack se encontró con un anciano, que le ofreció comprar la vaca por una semilla de guisante. Jack estuvo de acuerdo y se fue a casa. Allí encontró a su madre, quien se dio cuenta de que el dinero se gastó en nada y tiró la semilla por la ventana. Por la noche, cuando Jack y su madre dormían, la semilla brotó y se convirtió en un árbol alto. Por la mañana, Jack decidió trepar a este árbol. Lo intentó varias veces, pero siempre se caía. De repente, notó una sierra con una trenza que colgaba del árbol junto a él. Lo bajó y de repente una hermosa niña cayó directamente en sus brazos. Se casaron y vivieron felices para siempre. Para concluir, solo las acciones desinteresadas pueden traer la verdadera felicidad.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: En un bosque encantado vivieron una vez tres cerditos. Eran muy ruidosos y traviesos, reían constantemente y tocaban música. Otras criaturas del bosque, sus vecinos, se cansaron mucho de las travesuras de los cerditos y los expulsaron del bosque. La lección que se puede aprender de esta historia es que siempre debes guardar silencio en lugares públicos y preocuparte por los demás.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Masha narra el cuento de hadas llamado «El cerdero» con una moraleja inesperada: incluso las cosas más caras no convertirán a un cerdo en humano. La historia habla sobre una princesa traviesa a la que le gustaban tanto los juguetes inusuales que en realidad los prefería a cualquier criatura viviente. El Príncipe decidió darle una lección a la Princesa: se convirtió en un cerdero y vendió su olla mágica a la Princesa. No era una olla habitual, ¡pero podía cocinar mucha avena! Estaba tan emocionada por conseguir un juguete nuevo que ni siquiera le pidió al cerdero un hechizo mágico para que una olla dejara de cocinar la avena, así que tuvo que disculparse con el príncipe y empezar a ser más perspicaz.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Muy lejos en una casita cerca del ferrocarril vive una niña pequeña y muy inquieta llamada Masha. Le fascina tanto tocar música que los demás animales no comparten su entusiasmo, y siempre se esconden de ella. Un día, se harta de la situación y se escapa por el bosque.
